purpose: Improve complete learned dinner placement reliability by testing a new spoon release demonstration, preserving the selected v6 suite and all earlier failures.
intervention: Modify only the 39 existing training episodes' lowering, release and retract action labels. End lowering at a tool point 3 mm above its old final endpoint, by interpolating on that episode's existing descending path. Open the gripper over 1.0 seconds while holding active-arm joints stationary for 1.25 seconds; then perform the original sideways release path with the same joint offset for clearance. Taper that offset back to zero over the original retract. Keep durations, initial RGB features, all preceding/following actions and inactive-arm targets unchanged. This permits a small physical settling drop; acceptance still requires verified release, stable placement, parking, contact and disturbance checks.
training_data_gate: All 39 modified exact float32 trajectories must pass independent physical replay using the unchanged DinnerPhysicalMonitor before any training. Preserve every failure. Stop the protocol if this gate fails; do not silently retune the label transformation.

training.initialization: Warm-start selected v6 spoon weights and preserve its exact visual/action normalization. Only the target actions change.
training.loss: Mean squared normalized motor-target error; unchanged PrimitiveNet architecture.

development_gate: After export parity and input-hash checks, freeze both baseline and candidate suites before paired actual language/RGB-engine runs on both presets for every development seed. Require at least 5/6 complete candidate workflows per preset and no fewer complete workflows or passed spoon attempts than the baseline. Keep every refusal in its denominator.
promotion_gate: Freeze selected runtime/model sources before paired final runs on all 12 evaluation seeds and both presets. Require at least 10/12 complete candidate workflows per preset and at least two more complete workflows in total than the paired baseline. No acceptance tolerance, controller, other model or camera rule may change within this protocol. Report the full paired outcomes regardless of promotion.
scope: Release reliability in the existing finite dinner distribution, not arbitrary workspace coverage, continuous visual correction or an Intel run. Prior final scenes and the diagnostic traces are excluded from fitting and fresh physical selection. Preserve originals, private credentials and nonpersonal commit identity. GitHub/HF remain private and Submit remains reserved for the user.
